Head's up

This is a prototype. Most of the basic functionality is in place. The design is still a work in progress.

Introduction

Welcome to Color Picker 9000. The tool I use to create the stylesheets for this site.

This page is a live preview of the generated styles. Play around with the controls to get things the way you like. Copy the CSS at the bottom of the page when you're done and paste it into your stylesheet to use the settings.

The picker provides settings for five colors. This text uses base color. The heading at the top of the page uses the heading color and the link uses the accent color. There's also a warning color and an info color.

Each of the five colors have three variants: default, faded, and faint. The swatches further down on this page have previews of all of them.

Instructions
  1. Select the Mode you want to work on (either light or dark)
  2. Use the Background sliders to set a background color. As you do, the colors in the Colors section update automatically (each hue value rotates 45 degrees).
  3. Choose a color from the Colors section and use the "hue" buttons below it to select the hue portion of it's OKLCH value.
  4. Use the Lightness and Chroma sliders to adjust those values for the color.
  5. Copy the CSS block and paste it into your style sheet to start using the colors.
